reviews.author: bruhicanthaveanicknamw
reviews.title: Stop changing things and bring back the old stuff
reviews.body: I really like it since it has so many options and it’s generally a great thing, and without it would be bad and weird especially on weekends since that’s when I watch it most. But recently it updated and made it so that when you watch a video and click on all the videos made by that channel, it shows the longest videos instead of the most recent ones. And it says “recently uploaded” but I hate it a lot. I cannot see anything new that person has made unless I search up “____ newest videos” and that won’t work either  because the search thing is weird though I’m fine with the search. Also, you can’t report videos anymore (even tho I don’t have 2 report videos) and that’s just wrong. The more updates that come means the less I will actually use the app bc I have no idea how to do anything on it anymore. I don’t know why nobody else has talked about this because it’s the closest thing to making me stop using this. I understand if devs want bug fixes and stuff, but this one thing is terrible. Please get rid of this and bring back the line of videos when you click “videos” on someone’s channel, it was infinitely easier to find what vid you want. Ex: I want to watch their recent video. a button for that. I want to watch their oldest video. A button for that. I want to watch their most popular videos. A button for that. And now it’s just the longest videos in the “newest videos” section. Summary: the new update is garbage, please bring back the old page for “videos” on someone channel. Please.

reviews.author: Disappointed Hide.Me User
reviews.title: Default App Behavior Ruins Every Video Experience
reviews.body: When scrolling to select a video the moment you stop to read a title, or look at the poster frame, the video instantly starts playing.  By default there is no audio.  If you touch the video to watch it advertising will play, which is expected.  What’s not expected is that when the opportunity to leave the ads and go to the video appears, the video CONTINUES playing with audio, but 5, 10, or whatever number of seconds in from when you touched it.  This means in order to watch from the beginning the user must use the navigation.  Very annoying since the initial play back is silent and instantaneous before selecting the video for viewing.  After selection, and pre-roll ads the video should start from the BEGINNING.  Beyond that, this whole “instant play” thing when scrolling should be a user selectable feature that can be turned on or off.  Personally, I like to read the title and look at the poster frame before making a selection.  What’s the point of allowing the content providers to write titles and make custom poster frames if viewers aren’t able to see them?  If it were books instead of videos, it’d be like flashing the title and cover and then start instantly into the book’s text before I even know if I’m interested.  Also, auto-starting the video may spoil any given viewing experience by revealing something before the viewer is allowed to watch the video as the author intended.  PLEASE remove this behavior or allow the viewer to control it. Thank you.

reviews.author: frogman3126
reviews.title: Unnecessarily cluttered, non-intuitive, with multiple issues
reviews.body:
I am surprised at the percentage of 5-star ratings for this app which I find substandard especially given that the service is owned by Google. It is indeed cluttered and has an unnecessarily steep learning curve, but let’s be a little specific too. Among its (numerous) problems, if one searches for and saves a group of videos already packaged as a playlist — course lectures, say — it will appear as a playlist in your collection but not on the list of playlists accessed from the menu by which a new but related video could be added to it. Such a video, even though it would be most usefully seen in the context of the original collection, must be placed in a new playlist. Do they really need to protect the integrity of the original playlist? More: if a video download is (inadvertently?) deleted, the item stays on the list and is streamable for sure, but any attempt to re-download it fails, even though “Download again” is a menu item — and even if recaptured anew through a search and saved, it is recognized as the one previously deleted and will still fail to download. Mind you, I do have the Premium service.
   This is not to mention the sometimes excruciatingly slow download speeds for some videos. This is undoubtedly the consequence of poor bandwidth of the hosting server, not the fault of the app, BUT the app contributes to the problem by not fully supporting downloading when closed — even when it is open in the background, it is significantly slower. This almost forces you to keep the app open and in the foreground for the duration of a long download. A serious waste of my time. I’ll stop here, but only out of psychic fatigue.
